rows.text: Walking into the recycling station on the Rumbas system, you hear thousands upon thousands of trash dumps cheering from inside the garbage pile.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As ring master of the 21st Garbage Chef Championship, you view the observation shield, half-eaten Halovian Winged Burgers, currency from an unknown system, as well as the garbage thrown from the audience instead of flowers, as an expression of their hopes for you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You casually glance around at the challengers: Tatalov's palace chef, Erolyn, the molecular eater Risaac, who's tasted a thousand kinds of garbage, and the world-famous garbage gourmand Jacques Feaux. Every one of them is a demanding prospect.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: And yet, in your mind, the menu for victory has already been decided.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Just come at me all at once. I'm in a hurry.
Throw trash into the opponent's can.
Challenge the jury above your grade.
